feed.title: Frontier Nuclear (FNUC) warns on going concern after $50M raise
feed.summary: Frontier Nuclear & Minerals Inc. (FNUC) reported a net loss of $14.95 million for the six months ended December 31, 2025, an increase from $2.36 million a year prior, primarily due to higher stock-based compensation. The company raised $50.69 million through equity financing but disclosed material uncertainties regarding its ability to continue as a going concern due to an accumulated deficit of $57.49 million and no operating cash flow. Despite these concerns, management believes current capital and expected financing will sustain operations for at least 12 months, as FNUC repositions itself as a nuclear fuel cycle platform while expanding its uranium and battery metals projects.
